messages:
tariq: Quick heads-up — BlueWave (Dedicated) wants a dark-launch per-tenant canary. Start at 0.5% traffic, need token cap per-request and an isolation guard so noisy tenant can't spill into shared pools.
anna: +1. Do we have an API shape for per-tenant canaries? i.e. route param vs tenant-level rollout object?
lucy: route-level sounds cleaner for runtime routing. tenant-level is easier for the console UX. tradeoffs?
jeff: runtime: route-level can be plumbed through router with existing weight-based split. tenant-level needs a separate lookup table and adds qps to router. :thinking_face: 
marta: Also want observability: tenant-scoped latency/cost dashboards and per-canary SLI differences. If canary affects QPS distribution we need a per-tenant token meter.
tariq: Proposal: API accepts a `tenant_rollouts` block (admin-only) and the router caches it. SDK will still call same endpoint; routing decisions happen server-side. Console shows rollout per-tenant with sliders. (cc @console-bot)
console-bot: 1) UI: show active slices + quick rollback button 2) Warn if tenant quota < slice size :warning: 
anna: For the API schema, how about:
```
{
  "tenant_id": "bluewave",
  "rollouts": [
    {"variant": "model-v2", "traffic": 0.005},
    {"variant": "model-v1", "traffic": 0.995}
  ],
  "per_request_token_limit": 500
}
```
This keeps router lookup simple and supports per-request caps.
lucy: That JSON is fine but router should prefer integer-based weights to avoid float rounding issues in the hash-split algorithm.
jeff: Also need circuit-breaker: if the tenant's error rate > 5% over 5m, kill canary and route 100% to fallback. Where do we store that policy? per-tenant or global?
marta: Per-tenant overrides needed for enterprise customers. BlueWave will want control. Add a `failover_policy` field.
tariq: Agree. Add audit log entries and an operator can force-fallback from the console. Also must ensure Dedicated pool isolation: canary traffic for BlueWave should be constrained to their reserved pool, not shared GPU nodes.
anna: UI note: show expected token spend estimate for the slice and a checkbox "Enforce per-tenant quota".
jeff: Telemetry: emit `route.rollout.{tenant}.{variant}` metrics, and tag traces with tenant and rollout_id. We'll need per-tenant alerting thresholds too.
marta: Security: admin-only API key and RBAC. Also KMS for tenant config secrets.
lucy: Devops ask: can deploy-bot apply a staged canary to a subset of their dedicated nodes for BlueWave? that would reduce blast radius.
deploy-bot: I can create a shadow slice on dedicated nodes. Run `deploy-bot create-slice --tenant bluewave --nodes dedicated-1-3 --pct 0.5` :white_check_mark: 
tariq: Next steps: (1) define minimal API + schema, (2) wire router cache + hashed weight algorithm, (3) add CB + telemetry, (4) console mockups. I'll draft API PR and a short RFC.
anna: I'll pair on console mockups this afternoon. :eyes: 
jeff: I'll prototype breaker logic tomorrow and add unit tests for weight rounding.
marta: I'll draft the telemetry dashboard tiles and share a sample with BlueWave.
anna: sounds good — thanks everyone.
